description_en: Retrieves the list of scheduled tasks
name: ListScheduledTasks

parameters.help_en: The ID of the effective tenant
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

The maximum number of entries per page is 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页返回条目数。

每页返回数量上限30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The keyword of the rule name, used for fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称关键词，用于模糊匹配
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The ID of the collaboration group (such as cg_101). If specified, a group space task is created (the caller must be a valid group member). If left empty, a personal task is created
parameters.help_zh: 所属协作群组 ID（如 cg_101）；传入时创建群空间任务（调用者需为有效群成员），为空创建个人任务
parameters.name: collaboration_group_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return in this request
parameters.help_zh: 本次请求所返回的最大记录条数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next page
parameters.help_zh: 分页标，供分页使用，下一页token
parameters.name: next_token
